name: Sakai (Fukui, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakai city emblem in green and red: a green stylised swirl in two shades with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Sakai, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Sakai city emblem — a green stylised swirl in two shades with a red disc
